cloze.translation: 發明於台中的珍珠奶茶是世界最著名的台灣飲品。

clozeEasy.sentence: Night markets with stinky tofu and oyster omelets are a famous ___ culture.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: Night markets with stinky tofu and oyster omelets are a famous Taiwanese culture.
clozeEasy.translation: 賣臭豆腐和蚵仔煎的夜市是著名的台灣文化。

clozeEasy.sentence: Taipei 101, a famous ___ skyscraper, was the tallest building in the world for six years.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: Taipei 101, a famous Taiwanese skyscraper, was the tallest building in the world for six years.
clozeEasy.translation: 台灣地標台北101曾連續六年是世界最高樓。

clozeMedium.sentence: The ___ flag carries a white sun on a blue sky and a red earth below.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: The Taiwanese flag carries a white sun on a blue sky and a red earth below.
clozeMedium.translation: 台灣國旗是藍天白日和紅地。
clozeMedium.clue: 青天白日紅地旗的國家

clozeMedium.sentence: Many ___ families visit temples during Lunar New Year to pray for good luck.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: Many Taiwanese families visit temples during Lunar New Year to pray for good luck.
clozeMedium.translation: 許多台灣家庭過年時到廟裡祈福。

clozeHard.sentence: Unlike the bitter hot tea served at a traditional dinner table, ___ bubble tea is sweet, cold, and full of chewy pearls.
clozeHard.fullSentence: Unlike the bitter hot tea served at a traditional dinner table, Taiwanese bubble tea is sweet, cold, and full of chewy pearls.
clozeHard.translation: 傳統餐桌上的熱茶帶苦味，台灣珍珠奶茶則冰甜又有Q彈珍珠。

entries.zh: 美國（United States of America 的縮寫）
entries.example: The USA has fifty states.
entries.exampleZh: 美國有五十個州。

cloze.sentence: Passports issued in Washington, D.C., carry the three letters ___ on their dark blue cover.
cloze.fullSentence: Passports issued in Washington, D.C., carry the three letters USA on their dark blue cover.
cloze.translation: 華盛頓特區核發的護照深藍色封面上印有 USA 三個字母。

clozeEasy.sentence: The ___ is a country of fifty states between Canada and Mexico.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: The USA is a country of fifty states between Canada and Mexico.
clozeEasy.translation: 美國是介於加拿大和墨西哥之間、有五十州的國家。
clozeEasy.clue: 加拿大墨西哥之間的國家縮寫

clozeEasy.sentence: The dollar, the money of the ___, is used in trade all over the world.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: The dollar, the money of the USA, is used in trade all over the world.
clozeEasy.translation: 美元是美國的貨幣，在全球貿易通用。

clozeMedium.sentence: NASA, the space agency of the ___, first sent astronauts to the moon.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: NASA, the space agency of the USA, first sent astronauts to the moon.
clozeMedium.translation: 美國的太空總署NASA最先送太空人上月球。

clozeMedium.sentence: Basketball teams from the ___ often win gold at the Olympic Games.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: Basketball teams from the USA often win gold at the Olympic Games.
clozeMedium.translation: 美國的籃球隊常在奧運奪金。

clozeHard.sentence: The three letters ___ stand for a huge country that is made of fifty states.
clozeHard.fullSentence: The three letters USA stand for a huge country that is made of fifty states.
clozeHard.translation: USA 三個字母代表由五十州組成的大國。
clozeHard.clue: 由五十州組成的國家縮寫

entries.example: She wants to travel around the world someday.
entries.exampleZh: 她希望有一天能環遊世界。

cloze.sentence: Soccer fans from around the ___ watch the Cup finals every four years.
cloze.fullSentence: Soccer fans from around the world watch the Cup finals every four years.
cloze.translation: 來自世界各地的足球迷每四年觀看世界盃決賽。

clozeEasy.sentence: The Earth is the ___ we all live on, so we must protect it.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: The Earth is the world we all live on, so we must protect it.
clozeEasy.translation: 地球是我們共同生活的世界，必須保護它。

clozeEasy.sentence: There are more than seven billion people in the ___.
clozeEasy.fullSentence: There are more than seven billion people in the world.
clozeEasy.translation: 世界上有七十多億人口。

clozeMedium.sentence: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the ___.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
clozeMedium.translation: 聖母峰是世界最高的山。

clozeMedium.sentence: News from around the ___ reaches our phones in seconds.
clozeMedium.fullSentence: News from around the world reaches our phones in seconds.
clozeMedium.translation: 世界各地的消息幾秒內就傳到手機。

clozeHard.sentence: The ___ Record Book lists the tallest, fastest, and strangest achievements of all people.
clozeHard.fullSentence: The world Record Book lists the tallest, fastest, and strangest achievements of all people.
clozeHard.translation: 金氏世界紀錄收錄了最高、最快、最奇特的紀錄。
